'''Riva Denais''' was a legendary female holo-starlet known for her beauty. For a [[Time/Legends|time]], Denais dated the businessman [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]], but a sometime prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Denais was reported missing following an incident in [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] in which Stark and his partner [[Dominic Raynor]] were involved.<ref name="Viva Space Vegas!">{{SW|url=news/viva-space-vegas-the-history-of-the-marvelous-wheel-part-1|series=Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>
